key_insight: FORE estimates discounted occupancy ratios via a fitted fixed-point recursion on one-step transitions, avoiding Bellman completeness and relying only on ratio realizability.
engineering_relevance: This provides a more practical offline policy evaluation tool for computational RL pipelines, enabling reward reweighting, weighted FQE, and doubly robust value estimation from logged data.
method: Project the adjoint Bellman image onto a log-ratio hypothesis class using KL divergence.
Iterate a single-level density-ratio objective on one-step-transition data to fit occupancy ratios.
Use the fitted ratio for direct off-policy value estimation and as a component in doubly robust estimators.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports population KL contraction plus finite-sample regret bounds that converge to the true ratio up to approximation and statistical error.
watch_item: Performance depends on how well the occupancy-ratio class can represent the true ratio, and empirical guarantees scale with the complexity of that class.
paper_title: Fitted Occupancy-Ratio Evaluation without Bellman Completeness
